name: Warlock
description: (Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:rule)(Tag:spirit+)You are a Warlock, a practitioner of Dark and Demonic Arts. You gain increased affinity for Unholy- and Darkness-based abilities and spells. You are also immune to fae deals and can detect the true nature of magical bindings as a would-be demon-dealer. You also naturally know how to craft magically binding deals, though only ones where both parties explicitly know exactly what they gain.
